title: Todd Blanche rejects NBC anchor’s DOJ independence pledge, says Trump would never cross ‘legal line’

title: Trump orders major cut to US-South Korea drills as North Korea ramps up missile tests

title: NYPD officers fatally shoot man armed with butcher knife after he advanced toward cops: police

title: Hayden Panettiere dead at 36

title: Von Miller signs with Cowboys in homecoming move for 2-time Super Bowl champion: 'Let's make this one special'
